messages:
Evan Liu: Hey team — started today! Quick access questions: HubSpot CRM seat and Dialpad calling seat aren't showing up in my app launcher. Who should I ping to get these provisioned? Also where's the one-page call script/playbook I should read first? Thanks!
Priya (Sales Ops): Welcome Evan :tada: — ping me here for the HubSpot seat. I can request Dialpad but IT needs to confirm MFA enrollment first. Quick checklist I need from you: 1) work email, 2) team (AE/SDR/CS), 3) desired HubSpot role (Admin/Editor/Viewer). I'll start the HubSpot request now. cc @IT Helpdesk
Priya (Sales Ops): Ticket template (you can copy/paste):
```
To: sales-provisioning@redwood.ai
Name: Evan Liu
Email: evan.liu@redwood.ai
Role: AE
Team: Sales - Enterprise
Requested Apps: HubSpot (Editor), Dialpad
SSO Provider: Okta
```
Evan Liu: evan.liu@redwood.ai — Team: Sales - Enterprise, HubSpot role: Editor. Thanks Priya.
Priya (Sales Ops): Got it. Submitted HubSpot seat request (req# 2026-173). Dialpad ticket created (DT-4521) and I flagged IT for MFA check. Should be <24 hrs but will update here. :eyes: 
IT Helpdesk: Hi Evan — we saw the Dialpad ticket. Please complete Okta MFA enrollment so we can finish Dialpad provisioning: https://okta.redwood.internal/enroll. Reply here once done and we'll attach the Dialpad license.
Alex (CS): Hey Evan, welcome! For first-week reading grab the Sales Playbook (short) and call templates: https://docs.redwood.com/sales/playbook and https://repos.redwood.com/sales/call-templates. I just shared the call templates repo with Sales - Enterprise. If you want a quick walkthrough, ping me and we can do a 30m screen share.
Onboarding Bot: Welcome Evan! I've added the "Sales - Enterprise" onboarding checklist to your profile and sent calendar invites for: Sales Team Intro (30m), Product Overview (45m). Links: https://onboard.redwood/checklists/sales-enterprise.
Evan Liu: Done Okta MFA enrollment just now. Priya — ping me when Dialpad license is attached.
Priya (Sales Ops): Dialpad seat is live. Extension: 3442. HubSpot Editor role granted — you should see "Sales - Enterprise" pipeline and templates. Let me know if any seat permissions look off.
Evan Liu: Awesome, thanks everyone. Alex — can we schedule that 30m walkthrough today? My calendar is flexible after 3pm.
Alex (CS): Yup 4pm works, I'll send an invite and share the quick call script I use for enterprise discovery.
Evan Liu: Perfect — see you then. Thanks again :thumbsup:
